name: Discourse
tagline: Self-hosted forum platform API for topics, posts, users, and categories
description: Discourse is an open-source community forum platform with a REST API available on every Discourse site. Developers authenticate with an API key plus username headers to list topics, create posts, manage users, and moderate content on self-hosted or Discourse-hosted instances. There is no single multi-tenant public API host—each site exposes the same API at its own base URL.

auth.details: API key via HTTP headers: Api-Key and Api-Username (user the key acts as). Keys created in Admin → API. User API keys (for mobile/user apps) use different User-Api-Key headers.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Self-hosted open source: free (unlimited API on your instance). Hosted Discourse plans billed separately; API access included with site hosting—no published per-request free API tier.
pricing.paid_plans: Discourse hosting plans (Standard/Business/Enterprise) include site + API; pricing at discourse.org/pricing. Self-hosted is free software.

rate_limits: Per-site; default Discourse rate limits apply (e.g. admin can configure). Not a single global published number—depends on instance settings and user trust level.
use_cases: list latest topics from a Discourse forum
create a new topic or reply as a bot user
fetch a topic and its posts by ID or slug
search forum posts for a keyword
sync user or group membership with an external app
post status updates or announcements to a category
